CHANGELOG updated in BURROW: Phase 2 -- real parser parity shipped: parser.go, faithful hand-port of PARENA/src/parser.c+ast.h, verified against all 14 real test_lexer_parser.c scenarios plus a full 111-file real corpus stress test (zero failures) and a structural cross-check against parena parse's own dump (exact match). Also: new DUNG.md scoping doc -- 'the BURROW editor,' unified terminal+editor rewrite of PITVIPER+PARENA's own stdlib/editor, UX foundation adopted directly from EmilyOS's own gui-v0.1-design-capture.md (tmux x i3 hybrid layout, double-click-speed interaction contract). Scoping only, no DUNG code yet. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
